summary: A crowd-pleaser that hits the daily target, but the build merged the 1994 and 2019 Lion King into one entry. Restore the original and add year aliases, then run it.
reasons: Most players know 9 of the 10. The casual player found 7 in their first 8 guesses and Zootopia 2 later, then lost all five lives on famous near misses (Toy Story 4 #11, Toy Story 3 #12, Moana 2 #13, Finding Nemo, Shrek 2). Ne Zha 2 at #1 and Toy Story 5 at #10 are the reveals.

Data bug: rows that share a title are dropped, so the 1994 Lion King ($970.7M, source #20) is missing, everything from Finding Nemo down shows one rank too high, and #4 reads as plain 'The Lion King' with the remake's $1.66B.
Typing gaps: 'lion king 2019' and 'the lion king (2019)' are rejected as not on the list (that cost the fan #4), and so is 'super mario brothers'. Blitz is excellent: 21 of 22 names scored.
fixes: scripts/build.ts:327 dedups rows by normalized name, which drops The Lion King (1994, $970,707,763; #20 in table 0 and #1 in the traditional table) as a duplicate of the 2019 remake. Keep both, named 'The Lion King (2019)' (#4) and 'The Lion King (1994)' (#20); Finding Nemo becomes #21 and Monsters, Inc. #50.

Aliases: 'The Lion King 2019', 'Lion King 2019' and 'The Lion King remake' on the 2019 film; 'The Lion King 1994' and 'Lion King 1994' on the original. Decide where bare 'The Lion King' goes: kept on the 2019 film it stays a free #4 for casual players (as 'Avatar' is the 2009 film); shared, the game asks which one, and a player who picks the classic loses a life (casual drops to about 6-7).
Add 'Super Mario Brothers' and 'Mario Brothers' to The Super Mario Bros. Movie; both are rejected now.
Drop the bare 'Spider-Man' alias from Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse: 'spiderman' charges a life for #36 even when the player means Into the Spider-Verse, which isn't on the list.
Matcher (src/game, not data): 'cars' charges a life for Cars 2 through a word match, though Cars (2006) isn't on the list. A guess with no number shouldn't land on a numbered sequel of the same name.
